input_contract: Training RGB black-composited by dataset convention, supplied cameras and timestamps. Original alpha only composites RGB. No blue/yellow rules, static labels, object count, old S1 hull or weights. S1-A train-only RGB/LK evidence reused with hashes; no historical model weights.
hypothesis: Periodic confidence refresh can admit cross-temporally projected geometric regions beyond observed-track seeds, while suppressing image disagreement. Same candidate initialization, steps, optimizer and camera sequence in both arms.
confidence_rule: Observed-track regions initialize confidence0.95; geometrically supported color-compatible reprojected regions cap confidence0.85. Region needs >=2 distinct anchors, source span>=40 and no incompatible-track seed. Refresh target=geometry*(0.6+0.4*exp(-patch_L1/0.1)) if rendered alpha>0.3, else0.75*geometry; EMA rate0.5; threshold0.5. Unsupported geometry stays unknown irrespective of RGB fit. Confidence can decrease and revoke candidate supervision.
initialization_rule: Common conservative shell within0.18 world units of verified RGB-geometric anchors; >=8 positive projected candidate views, >=12 frustum views, >=2 positives in >=2 global time thirds. Initialize opacity0.1. No candidate sweep or learned segmentation.
interpretation: Mechanism inspired by Cross-Temporal 3DGS, not paper replication: no high-quality historical scene or DUSt3R prior available. Projection color agreement and local region smoothness are assumptions, not independent geometry GT.
evaluation: Frozen S1-A seed masks as common training proxy, disjoint val cameras evaluated only after training with separately inferred geometric regions; confidence coverage and revocation, observed native86/188 and early/middle/late RGB, original200-camera video, unchanged camera hashes and historical checkpoints. No novel-view GT or complete static reconstruction claim from fitted masks.
